## 🛠 Prompt Framework

1. Role
2. Task
3. Context
4. Constraints

## ❌ Bad Prompt

---

## ✅ Good Prompt

> You are a data analyst. Analyze this dataset and return 3 key insights in bullet points. Focus on trends and anomalies.
